value: Kildahl, H., Wang, L., Tong, L. and Ding, Y. (2023). Cost effective decarbonisation of blast furnace - basic oxygen furnace steel production through thermochemical sector coupling. Journal of Cleaner Production 389, 135963. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jclepro.2023.135963

Locators are printed journal page numbers (pp.1-7 = PDF pages 1-7). A 7-page first-principles/techno-economic concept paper: one technology, the thermochemical (BCNF1 perovskite CO2-splitting) retrofit of a BF-BOF, sized for a UK site of around 3 Mt/yr. Loaded: description, state of development, incremental TC electricity 607 kWh/tls (additional to the BF-BOF, not a whole-plant SEC), per-site capex GBP 359 million (perovskite 209 + reactors 150; incremental), site capacity 3 Mt/yr, CO2 reduction 94%, and a derived whole-site 0.113 t CO2eq/t. Flows: per-tls iron ore, scrap, blast air, BOF oxygen, CO reductant and recycled top/BOF gas (Sect. 4.1, Fig. 1). Other-values: recovered gas heat, coke-oven saving, coke savings and oxygen sales (savings, not loaded), payback and reprinted context figures. No price year stated (GBP 2023 assumed); no lifetime, opex or discount rate; energy figures without heating-value basis. The system is at laboratory scale (below the database TRL 5-6 scope).
